text: Thank you for approving my application.
Ah, I can't wait to meet my mother.
Please allow me to pray to the Holy Mother once more.
Since he intends to pray, you prepare not to disturb him.
Before leaving, you think of something else and turn back to look at him. He has already placed his necklace in his palm, and his sincere, devout appearance leaves you with mixed feelings.
Did you go to explore the streets earlier?
That was merely... part of my duty as a Witness!
You try to suppress a smile, step out of the room, and give him space.
